title: fvcStructureRangeland3D: 2D-to-3D label transfer and 3D vegetation model benchmarking for rangelands
description:
Python software and workflow for transferring 2D vegetation growth-form labels into georeferenced 3D UAS LiDAR point clouds (the fvc3d package), and for preparing the labelled tiles used to benchmark 3D vegetation models in semi-arid rangelands, as described in Sotomayor et al. (2026), From 2D labels to 3D structure.

Install: pip install fvc3d. Guide: https://lnsotom.github.io/fvc_structure/
notes: The code snapshot cited in the preprint and in Chapter 3 of the PhD thesis is tag 2026.28.4 (28 April 2026). v0.1.0 adds the installable fvc3d package.
